item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Sprout Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Sprout Lunch Menu: A selection of fresh seasonal vegetables that you can combine with a protein of your choice to create your own meal salad.

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Homebound Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Homebound Lunch Menu: Pork tenderloin stew with sausages, bacon and mushrooms. Served with creamy mashed potatoes and pickles.

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Globetrotter Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Globetrotter Lunch Menu: General Tao chicken with rice, baby corn and bell pepper. Served with fresh coleslaw. GREEN DISH: Dish General Tao tofu with rice, baby corn and bell pepper. Served with fresh coleslaw.

item.title: 🍽 HUB3 - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB3 - Lunch Menu: Chicken biryani with turmeric rice, topped with crispy onions. (15) GREEN DISH: Dish Aubergine biryani with turmeric rice, topped with crispy onions. (15)

item.title: 🍽 HUB2 - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB2 - Lunch Menu: Bao buns with slow-baked pork, served with pickled daikon and carrots and fresh, crisp Chinese cabbage. Topped with a soy, sesame and chilli dressing and sprinkled with fresh herbs. GREEN DISH: Dish Bao buns with marinated tofu, served with pickled daikon and carrots and fresh, crisp Chinese cabbage. Topped with a soy, sesame and chilli dressing and sprinkled with fresh herbs.

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 – Kays - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 – Kays - Lunch Menu: Dal Gosht, slow-cooked lamb curry with lentils, served with chopped parsley and warm naan bread. Served with Indian rice salad, mango achaar, coriander, yoghurt and chilli sauce. Also available gluten-free.
